This *could* be in core because even more lightweight game engines like [Orx](https://github.com/orx/orx) has this, see for instance this API: https://github.com/orx/orx/blob/5c01d089fc452ee8d78e3a238b73775769091f2e/code/include/object/orxSpawner.h

I'd like to implement what I proposed above in [Goost](https://goostengine.github.io/), regardless of whether this proposal is approved to be implemented in Godot.

Feedback welcome! I'm interested in what kind of functionality you'd find essential and useful.
